info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Harrier Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Harrier Notebook Detail Submission API facilitates the creation and registration of detailed specifications for Harrier notebooks within the catalog. This API allows businesses to enrich their product listings by contributing comprehensive data about notebook features, specifications, and availability. Typical consumers include product managers and e-commerce platforms aiming to enhance their catalog offerings. By utilizing this API, users can ensure that their Harrier notebook details are accurately captured, enabling better customer information and potentially increasing sales.

post.summary: Create details for a harrier notebook.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create and submit detailed information for a harrier notebook. It processes the request payload to save the provided details into the database for further usage.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for the operation related to the Harrier notebook. It must adhere to the defined schema and should include all required fields to ensure a successful operation.

200.description: The request was successful and the details are returned.

CreateCatalogHarrierNotebookDetailReques.title: Harrier Notebook Request Body

harrier_notebook_id.description: The unique identifier for the Harrier notebook.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the notebook.

quantity.description: The quantity of Harrier notebooks requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of each Harrier notebook.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the Harrier notebook.

CreateCatalogHarrierNotebookDetailReques.description: Schema representing the request body for creating or updating a Harrier notebook operation.

Dimensions.title: Notebook Dimensions

width.description: The width of the Harrier notebook in specified units.

height.description: The height of the Harrier notebook in specified units.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions (e.g., centimeters, inches).

Dimensions.description: Schema representing the dimensions of a Harrier notebook.

CreateCatalogHarrierNotebookDetailRespon.title: Response for Creating or Updating Notebook Details

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the notebook record.

processedAt.description: The timestamp of when the record was processed.

matchedCount.description: The count of matched records related to the operation.

pricing.description: Pricing details associated with the notebook.

CreateCatalogHarrierNotebookDetailRespon.description: This schema represents the response returned when successfully creating or updating notebook details.

PricingDetails.title: Pricing Details

net.description: The net price of the notebook.

currency.description: The currency in which the net price is denominated.

taxIncluded.description: Indicates whether the net price includes tax.

PricingDetails.description: This schema defines the pricing structure for notebook operations including net price and tax information.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource being returned in the response.

x-processing-time.description: The total time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
